metadata.title: Phase 2C.5B3 WebRTC File DataChannel Implementation Contract

requirements.observable_behavior: Agent registers OnDataChannel listener recognizing inbound client-created DataChannel labeled 'file-channel'
requirements.notes: Static disassembly proves OnDataChannel callback closure at AMD64 0x9e2f20/0x9e2f40 and ARM64 0x53f210/0x53f234

requirements.observable_behavior: DataChannel 'file-channel' is negotiated with ordered=true delivery
requirements.notes: Static disassembly proves ordered=1 byte pointer; corroborated by frontend pc.createDataChannel('file-channel', { ordered: true })

requirements.observable_behavior: Upload begins with a JSON text frame on file-channel containing type 'start_upload' and fields 'filename' (string), 'size' (integer), 'sha256' (hex string), and 'install' (boolean)
requirements.notes: Static disassembly at AMD64 0x9e9ab1 logs: [FileChannel] Start uploading to %s (size=%d, sha256=%s, install=%v)

requirements.observable_behavior: Subsequent frames on file-channel are received as raw binary chunks ([]byte) and forwarded to the active file transfer sink
requirements.notes: Framing matrix confirms HYBRID_METADATA_JSON_AND_BINARY_CHUNKS; log: [FileChannel] Error writing to file: %v

requirements.requirement: Streaming SHA-256 Checksum Calculation & Integrity Check
requirements.observable_behavior: Agent calculates streaming SHA-256 over incoming binary chunks; upon receiving declared size, verifies hash against metadata sha256
requirements.notes: Static strings prove [FileChannel] SHA-256 integrity check passed: %s and [FileChannel] Upload integrity check FAILED: %v

requirements.observable_behavior: Agent tracks accumulated chunk byte count against metadata size. When cumulative received bytes equal declared size, transfer completes; overflow or early termination aborts transfer
requirements.notes: Static string confirms [FileChannel] Upload finished: %s (%d bytes)

requirements.observable_behavior: Original binary targets destination directory /data/local/tmp for file staging and temp APK files
requirements.notes: Static strings confirm /data/local/tmp/install_%s.apk and [FileChannel] Failed to copy APK to /data/local/tmp: %v

requirements.observable_behavior: File-channel handler enforces state machine transitions: IDLE -> METADATA_ACCEPTED -> RECEIVING -> COMPLETE (or ERROR). Chunks before metadata, duplicate metadata, or premature termination transition to ERROR
requirements.notes: Explicit 4-state state machine is an implementation choice for robust session lifecycle management

requirements.observable_behavior: Handlers interface through an abstract FileSink interface exposing Begin(metadata), WriteChunk(bytes), Complete(), and Abort() without direct filesystem scattering
requirements.notes: FileSink interface decoupling is an architectural implementation choice allowing test sandbox injection

requirements.observable_behavior: Test doubles provide in-memory byte accumulation (MemoryFileSink) and temporary directory isolation, preventing test writes outside sandbox
requirements.notes: MemoryFileSink test double enables safe unit and E2E verification without disk contamination

requirements.requirement: Defensive Path Traversal & Malformed Name Sanitization
requirements.observable_behavior: Filenames containing directory traversal sequences (..), absolute paths, Windows drive letters, UNC paths, or NUL characters are sanitized/rejected to prevent filesystem escape
requirements.notes: SanitizeFilename implementation choice hardens against directory traversal

requirements.observable_behavior: When install=true in metadata and checksum verification succeeds, file channel notifies a PostUploadActionRequested hook/channel with the completed file path
requirements.notes: Event hook decouples file transfer protocol completion from subsequent package manager execution

requirements.observable_behavior: No shell execution, pm install, pm uninstall, or package manager commands are invoked during Phase 2C.5B3. Package installation logic remains strictly deferred
requirements.notes: Phase 2C.5B3 is restricted to file transfer protocol parity; execution of pm commands is deferred

requirements.observable_behavior: Channels 'camera-channel', 'ai-command-channel', and 'adb-channel' remain strictly deferred with inert lifecycle hooks only
requirements.notes: Accidental implementation of business logic on deferred channels is strictly prohibited in B3

requirements.observable_behavior: Client initiates transfer via sendFileChannelCmd({type: 'start_upload', filename, size, sha256, install}) and sendFileChannelChunk(arrayBuffer) as observed in reference frontend
requirements.notes: Reference-only client behavior from web-app useWebRTC.js

requirements.requirement: Original Android Agent Runtime Parity Oracle
requirements.observable_behavior: Executing original compiled Android agent binary against authentic Android OS environment
requirements.notes: Authentic Android execution environment is unavailable in host CI/CD environment
